headline: BYU edges Texas Tech and Baylor at the top
dek: Baylor has won 18 matches this season, more than any other program in the conference, and still trails BYU in the table. The difference is defeats: BYU has lost fewer conference matches than any other side.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Colorado has outscored every side above it in the table and passed none of them: in this conference, goals have not decided the order at the top.

wire.line: Iowa State has won four matches this season, none of them in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published. Apart from West Virginia's trip to Princeton, each involves Arizona State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Brooke Goerish has kept eight shutouts in Colorado's goal.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Arizona has drawn six matches this season, more than it has won.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Twelve different players have scored for Arizona State this season.

last_match.line: Houston came in off back-to-back defeats by Baylor.

next_match.line: BYU lost the first meeting, in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
